description: Halftone dot field extracted from an image. Coordinates are in pixels with the origin at the top-left and y increasing downward, in the same space as `width` x `height`. `dots` is a flat array with the given `stride` per dot: [x, y, radius] when stride is 3, or [x, y, radius, r, g, b] (color channels 0-255) when stride is 6. `radius` is the dot's half-size in pixels and `dotShape` says how to draw it (circle/square/diamond, or a 2:0.6 aspect line rotated by `angle` degrees). Edge dots may extend up to one grid spacing beyond the width/height bounds (they render partially at the boundary), so do not assert coordinates strictly inside the field. For instanced rendering (e.g. three.js InstancedMesh), load `dots` into a Float32Array and step by `stride`. `params` is the full generator recipe for reproducing this output.
